name: Oreka
desc: Permissionless prediction markets on ICP mainnet.
detail: Create and deploy your own prediction market on the Internet Computer without platform approval. Choose the price target and expiry, take a position, and follow the market through its outcome and settlement.
value: Permissionless market deployment, trading positions, outcome settlement, and reward claims across Motoko canisters and a TypeScript interface.
caption: Market outcome, position chart, and trading controls
alt: Oreka showing the market outcome, position chart, strike and final prices, trading controls, and market rules

name: Haze API
desc: Private prepaid credits for API access.
detail: Zero-knowledge proofs and a custom x402 adapter connect prepaid credits to an AI chat API. A local sidecar handles client integration, with readiness checks, spend limits, and durable pause controls on the service.
value: Proof verification, credit accounting, API adapters, and operational controls in one system.
caption: Client integration · Codex session using ZK Credits · supplied product capture
alt: Terminal client session showing a returned response with GPT-4o Mini through ZK Credits

name: Chakra
desc: A swap router that returns the quote and the route behind it.
detail: A Rust quote service combines liquidity venues from Redis pool snapshots. The TypeScript interface displays the returned amount, minimum received, price impact, and selected route; Solidity contracts handle execution through Permit2.
value: Rust routing and indexing, Solidity execution, a TypeScript SDK, and the swap interface.
caption: Live quote · 100 USDC → 113.927499 EURC via presto-hub
alt: Chakra returned quote for 100 USDC to 113.927499 EURC with price impact, minimum received, and presto-hub route

name: Kamui
desc: The first elliptic-curve VRF verification on Solana.
detail: Implemented an elliptic-curve verifiable random function (ECVRF) with on-chain proof verification on Solana. The oracle generates and submits the proof; the program verifies it and stores the fulfilled randomness for applications to consume.
value: Rust cryptography and Solana proof verification, an oracle fulfillment service, and a TypeScript demo that displays the generated random number and derived dice and coin outcomes.
caption: Fulfilled request · 92,398, dice roll, coin flip, and full VRF output · demo at 2:22
alt: Kamui fulfilled request showing Random number generated, result 92,398, dice roll 6, coin flip Tails, and expanded 256-bit VRF output

name: MGK Exchange
desc: Perpetual futures with batch-auction matching on Solana.
detail: Orders collect within a batch, clear through a dual-flow auction, and settle on-chain. Separate Rust programs handle custody and positions, matching, and the fallback oracle, alongside a TypeScript SDK, keeper, indexer, and trading interface.
value: Matching logic, cross-margin portfolios, persistent orders, liquidation handling, and the batch settlement lifecycle.
caption: Trading interface · chart and order book
alt: MGK Exchange devnet trading interface with candlestick chart, order book, and order entry
